description: Oscillator running the NES triangle-wave engine over a 32-step waveform drawn by hand rather than the chip's fixed ramp

params.text: Sets the pitch in semitones, 54 either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets the level of that step of the 32-step waveform, 0 to 15, with the zero crossing between 7 and 8; click or drag on the column to set it

inputs.text: Raises the pitch by an octave per volt, and its channel count sets the channel count of the output

notes: the output carries as many channels as the v/o input, so nothing sounds while that jack is empty.
